all_page_side_block_cv.interpretation: Contiguous-block extrapolation does not support a universal smooth-drift predictor; changepoint trees are worse. End blocks are one-sided extrapolation and therefore not a clean interpolation test.

exact_stratum_pairwise_distance.conditioning: same section + same Currier + same hand
exact_stratum_pairwise_distance.interpretation: A graded physical-distance relationship survives exact metadata matching.

largest_exact_stratum.selected_dp_segments: BIC usually chooses 2 segments, with the split tracking the physically separated reappearance of the same stratum around the leaf-56 / leaf-87 gap.
largest_exact_stratum.interpretation: Across the full exact stratum, smooth interpolation improves about 10.5% over the stratum mean and beats explicit changepoints on average.

largest_contiguous_subblock.definition: Herbal / Currier A / hand 1, physical leaves <=56
largest_contiguous_subblock.interpretation: Inside the main continuous block, neither smooth drift nor changepoints improve predictive error. The strong full-stratum distance gradient is therefore not well described as a single smooth trajectory throughout the contiguous block.

decision: H56-2 is only partially supported. Physical locality is real after exact metadata matching, but the data favor a mixed description: broad state blocks / separated recurrences plus local similarity, rather than one globally smooth physical drift or a small set of sharp changepoints. Proceed to latent-dimensionality/state representation rather than forcing a univariate physical-order model.
